skill.name: resume-bullet-extraction
skill.description: Turns completed project work into concise resume bullets using action verbs, technical context, and measurable impact.
skill.summary: Creates polished resume bullets from completed technical work.

content.value_statement: Completed work is often hard to summarize for resumes. This skill turns project details into concise, impact-focused bullets with clear technologies and metrics.
actual_capabilities: Applies an action-verb, work, technical-context, and impact formula.
Provides bullet templates for features, performance work, bug fixes, and refactoring.
Encourages metrics for performance, reliability, business impact, and scale.
Checks bullets for specificity, ownership, concise wording, and recruiter clarity.
Suggests resume section placement for different accomplishment types.
Uses guided questions to refine impact, technical depth, and differentiation.
limitations: Does not verify metrics; users must provide truthful measurements or estimates.
Does not rewrite a full resume or manage document formatting.
Focuses on technical project accomplishments, not every career field.
Does not save files by itself; it describes a suggested story file location.

use_cases.title: Summarize Completed Projects
use_cases.description: Turn recent engineering work into resume bullets that include technologies, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Promotion Evidence
use_cases.description: Convert team contributions into accomplishment statements that show scope, impact, and technical judgment.

use_cases.title: Improve Career Coaching Sessions
use_cases.description: Use structured prompts to help candidates explain projects with stronger action verbs and clearer results.

prompt_templates.title: Draft One Bullet
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the resume-bullet-extraction skill. Turn this completed work into one resume bullet: [describe the project, technologies, and result].

prompt_templates.title: Add Measurable Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the resume-bullet-extraction skill. Improve this bullet by adding truthful metrics and technical context: [paste bullet and known measurements].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Bullet Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the resume-bullet-extraction skill. Create three resume bullet options for this work, each emphasizing a different impact angle: [project details].

prompt_templates.title: Build A STAR Story Bullet
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the resume-bullet-extraction skill. From this STAR story, extract two resume-ready bullets and recommend the best resume section: [situation, task, action, result].

output_examples.input: I built a login system with JWT and Redis for a React and Node.js app.
output_examples.output: Engineered JWT authentication with refresh token rotation using Node.js, React, and Redis, reducing session risk for production users.

output_examples.input: I made a slow API faster by adding indexes and changing queries.
output_examples.output: Optimized database queries through index analysis and query restructuring, reducing average API response time from 800ms to 120ms.

output_examples.input: I fixed duplicate checkout charges caused by a race condition.
output_examples.output: Resolved checkout race conditions by implementing optimistic locking, preventing duplicate charges during high-traffic purchase flows.

best_practices: Provide technologies, constraints, and measurable outcomes before asking for bullets.
Replace vague estimates with verified metrics when accurate numbers are available.
Keep each bullet to one sentence that a technical recruiter can understand.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent results or metrics that the work does not support.
Do not provide only a job title without project details or outcomes.
Do not keep weak phrases such as responsible for, helped with, or worked on.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates concise resume bullets from completed work, with action verbs, technical context, and impact.

faq.question: Can it help if I do not have exact metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest reasonable impact areas, but you should only use numbers you can defend.

faq.question: Is it only for software engineers?
faq.answer: It is strongest for technical projects, but the formula can support other project-based roles.

faq.question: Does it write a full resume?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on individual accomplishment bullets and where they may fit in a resume.

faq.question: Can it produce several versions of one bullet?
faq.answer: Yes. You can ask for versions that emphasize scale, performance, business value, or technical depth.

faq.question: How should I prepare input for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the work completed, tools used, problem solved, users affected, and any measured result.
